salinity_tolerance_class: sensitive (species-level); BARI Mung-6 described as saline-tolerant in Bangladesh guidance
vegetative_tolerance: Salt-sensitive; impaired growth and seed production reported for mungbean (not BARI Mung-6-specific)
reproductive_tolerance: Seed yield strongly reduced by salt treatments in mungbean experiments (not a field ECe threshold)
notes: Polder 30 Batiaghata mungbean saturation-extract soil ECe: initial 2.31, development 2.02, mid 2.25, late 2.42 dS/m; yield 0.96 t/ha (Table 3). These are observations, NOT a yield-loss threshold or variety tolerance limit. Paper does not identify BARI Mung-6 by name. BARI Mung-6 variety described as saline tolerant by Bangladesh government, without a verified threshold here.
